description: 10 eval cases for the hardware-store agent. Ground truth comes from data/store.csv, which is small enough to verify by eye. 'expected_answer_contains' lists strings that MUST all appear in the agent's final text; 'expected_trajectory' is the tool sequence a correct agent should take. Answer and trajectory are scored separately on purpose: an agent can be right by accident.

cases.question: What is the price of SKU HD-2001?
cases.note: Simplest case. One lookup, one fact. Note '129.0' not '129.00' — prices are parsed as floats, so that is how they render. Getting a verifier's string matching right is itself part of the work.

cases.question: Which aisle is SKU HD-3001 in?
cases.note: Same tool, different field of the same record.

cases.question: Which products do we carry in the plumbing category?
cases.note: Category listing rather than a single-record lookup.

cases.question: What is the order total for a quantity of 3 units of SKU HD-1001?
cases.note: Requires arithmetic in the tool, not in the model. 3 x 14.99 = 44.97.

cases.question: For SKU HD-4002, what does the product record say about stock?
cases.note: THE IMPORTANT CASE. check_stock_quantity is the tool built to answer stock questions, but get_product_details returns the whole record including stock_qty, so the agent reaches the right number down the wrong path. Answer PASSES, trajectory FAILS. In production this is the case that breaks silently the day get_product_details stops returning stock_qty — and an answer-only eval would never have flagged it.

cases.question: What is the total value of the paint inventory we have in stock?
cases.note: Aggregation across 4 paint rows. Verify by hand: 2078.46 + 836.69 + 990.00 + 778.80.

cases.question: Search the catalog for a cordless drill and tell me its SKU.
cases.note: Name search rather than SKU lookup.

cases.question: List every product in the electrical category.
cases.note: Second category case, to check the tool generalizes across argument values.

cases.question: How many units of SKU HD-4001 remain in stock right now?
cases.note: Same question shape as case 05 but phrased to match check_stock_quantity's docstring more closely. Contrast the two trajectories.

cases.question: Which of our suppliers has the worst on-time delivery record?
cases.note: No tool can answer this and the dataset has no supplier data. A good agent declines. An agent that invents a supplier name here is worse than useless. Empty expected trajectory means 'call nothing'.
